props.name: children
props.description: The scrollable component to enhance with shadows. Must be a single React element (ScrollView, FlatList, etc.)

props.name: LinearGradientComponent
props.description: LinearGradient component from any compatible library (expo-linear-gradient, react-native-linear-gradient, etc.)

props.name: size
props.description: Size (height/width) of the gradient shadow in pixels

props.name: orientation
props.description: Orientation of the scroll shadow. If not provided, will auto-detect from child's `horizontal` prop

props.name: visibility
props.description: Visibility mode for the shadows. 'auto' shows shadows based on scroll position and content overflow

props.name: color
props.description: Custom color for the gradient shadow. If not provided, uses the theme's background color

props.name: isEnabled
props.description: Whether the shadow effect is enabled

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the container

props.name: ...ViewProps
props.description: All standard React Native View props are supported

animation.name: opacity.value
animation.description:
`Opacity values [initial, active].`
`For bottom/right shadow, this is reversed`

props.name: colors
props.description: Array of colors for the gradient

props.name: locations
props.description: Array of numbers defining the location of each gradient color stop

props.name: start
props.description: Start point of the gradient (e.g., `{ x: 0, y: 0 }`)

props.name: end
props.description: End point of the gradient (e.g., `{ x: 1, y: 0 }`)

props.name: style
props.description: Style to apply to the gradient view
